description: This Java class, SimulatorHelper, provides functionality to manage and run a simulator process, check for the presence of the simulator binary, start the simulator, and create a GUI component (button) to trigger starting the simulator as part of a UI application. It interacts with network ports, external IO classes, and handles process management.

classes.name: SimulatorHelper
classes.description: Utility class for managing the simulation process and UI integration in the application.

methods.name: isBinaryHere
methods.description: Checks if the simulator binary executable file exists.

methods.name: startSimulator
methods.description: Starts the simulator process in a separate thread, sets stimulation mode, and waits for the TCP port to open, indicating the simulator is ready.

methods.name: createSimulatorComponent
methods.description: Creates a GUI component (button or label) to start the simulator or indicate its status.

methods.name: onWindowClosed
methods.description: Destroys the process if it is running when the window is closed.
